commands.label: module-build
argv: source /opt/openfoam13/etc/bashrc && cp -a /src /tmp/incompressibleFluid && export FOAM_LIBBIN=/out && cd /tmp/incompressibleFluid && wmake libso

commands.label: container-main
argv:
useradd -o -u 1001 -m runner && su runner -s /bin/bash -c 'source /opt/openfoam13/etc/bashrc
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/instrumented:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
cd /case
blockMesh > log.blockMesh 2>&1 || exit $?
LD_DEBUG=libs LD_DEBUG_OUTPUT=/case/log.loader foamRun > log.foamRun 2>&1
exit $?
'

commands.label: container-disabled-control
argv:
useradd -o -u 1001 -m runner && su runner -s /bin/bash -c 'source /opt/openfoam13/etc/bashrc
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/instrumented:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
cd /case
blockMesh > log.blockMesh 2>&1 || exit $?
LD_DEBUG=libs LD_DEBUG_OUTPUT=/case/log.loader foamRun > log.foamRun 2>&1
exit $?
'

scope: AMR mean-quality experiment; no original peak/spectrum or physical verdict

instrumentation.measurement_noninterference: UNVERIFIED until disabled-capture final U/p control matches
instrumentation.reference_evaluation: Real-space g=((1+cos(q))/2)^4 and g'=-2*sin(q)*((1+cos(q))/2)^3; independent of forcing Fourier implementation.
